what: HIGH (code audit AUD-20260927-CA-B02-fc-geometry-join-ignores-strategy): scripts/ml/fc_geometry_resolve.py:_join_real_r() matches the 'real arm' of the fc-geometry shadow-soak counterfactual comparison by (symbol, closest closed-trade timestamp within 900s) ONLY -- it never filters on trades.strategy_name or account, although the soak row it is resolving for carries both (r.get('strategy'), r.get('account_id')) and config/strategies.yaml currently runs 9 distinct strategies on BTCUSDT alone (turtle_soup, trend_donchian, fade_breakout_4h, squeeze_breakout_4h, vwap, ict_scalp_5m, fvg_range_15m, htf_pullback_trend_2h, trend_donchian_1h) that can each close a BTCUSDT trade within the same 900s window. Reproduced: a synthetic trades table with two strategies closing BTCUSDT trades 3 and 5 minutes apart returns the WRONG strategy's realized R (-3.0 instead of the correct +2.0) for a soak row belonging to the other strategy. This corrupts the real-vs-fc-scaled-counterfactual comparison (MB-20260705-FC-SLTP-GEOMETRY) that scripts/ml/fc_geometry_resolve.py exists to produce -- the evidence for a live SL/TP-geometry design decision. No test file exists for this script. LOCATION: scripts/ml/fc_geometry_resolve.py:119-147 (_join_real_r), called at :214. PROPOSED FIX: pass strategy_name (and ideally account_id) from the soak row into _join_real_r and add a 'WHERE strategy_name=?' clause; add a regression test with two concurrent same-symbol, different-strategy closes.
